items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: and Howard Johnson, he loaned me his flute -- he had two.

ctx.x: with his flute; I still couldn't play that one. Then he taken his flute back, after he saw that I wasn't doing anything with it, and Howard Johnson, he loaned me his flute -- he had two. I couldn't play his flute either.

So I guess I just wasn't meant to be a flute player. And I love the instrument. I love flute. Like they say, I'm just a one-instrument man. Take me away from the alto, and I'm lost with everything else.
